settings.resourceMetricsHint: Low-frequency sampling runs every 3s, only while Preferences is open. Colors show app-level pressure for the Shiori process; this WebView does not expose exact GPU load, so Shiori shows the GPU's vendor and renderer instead.
settings.resourceMetricsError: Native process metrics are unavailable right now.

settings.resourceMetricsUnsupported: Live resource metrics aren't available on this platform yet.

betaDisclaimer.title: A quick note before you start
betaDisclaimer.body1: Shiori is still in beta, so please keep a backup of anything important before editing it here — especially PDFs that have already been edited in other apps. Those can carry quirks that make saves go sideways.
betaDisclaimer.body2: Everything stays on your device. If you hit a bug, I'd love to hear about it — but during the beta I can't take responsibility for edits that don't come through cleanly.
betaDisclaimer.footerHint: You can reopen this note any time from Settings → About.
